segments.name: Financial services solutions
segments.description: Provides payments, digital banking, prepayment and credit solutions to Brazilian micro-merchants, SMBs and Key Accounts.
segments.evidence: We currently operate in a single business segment mainly composed of financial services solutions, in which we offer payments, digital banking, and credit solutions, tailoring our Ton offering mostly for micro-merchants, and our Stone solution for SMBs.

revenueModel.text: Merchants and clients pay StoneCo fees for payment processing, subscription services and equipment rental, prepayment financing discounts, and interest and charges on credit and banking solutions.

changes.text: In 2025, StoneCo agreed to sell its Software Businesses and Simplesvet, classified them as discontinued operations, and moved from financial and software segments to a single operating segment.
changes.evidence: In the second quarter of 2025, we entered into two separate agreements to sell our Software Businesses and Simplesvet.

changes.text: The Software Businesses segment, largely acquired in 2021, was fully divested in February 2026.
